title: Witch Coven Ritual
description: Three blonde women in a gothic cathedral setting perform a dark ritual surrounded by dozens of lit black candles. A standing woman in a blue corset holds a smoking rope while another kneels before her; a third woman in a black velvet dress and crown stands on stone steps observing.
prompt: Three beautiful blonde women conducting a dark occult ritual inside a gothic cathedral with large stained glass windows. One woman stands wearing a tight blue denim corset and black lace gloves, holding a smoking rope. Another kneels before her in a matching blue corset and fishnet stockings. A third woman stands on stone steps wearing a long black velvet dress and a black crown. Blue magical smoke swirls around them. The stone floor is covered with dozens of lit black candles dripping wax. Dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
